title: SE/ProServices Gatekeeper Standup — onramp pulse (2028-07-27)
content:
TL;DR:
- Focus this week: gated rollouts for prefix caching + KV isolation for Dedicated tenants. Two customers in canary (Veridian, BlueCove). Tidewater delayed pending infra IP whitelisting.
- Immediate risk: KV eviction bug under sustained burst (seen in canary) — causes 5-10% token replay on tail latency. Engineering prioritizing a fix (RW-INT-1347) with a 48–72h ETA.

Attendees:
- Claire Donovan (SE, leads gatekeeper)
- Aisha Patel (ProServices, onboarding lead)
- Marco Alvarez (Platform Eng)
- Ravi Menon (SRE)
- Samir Gupta (Customer Success)
- Janice Lo (QA) — joined for verification notes

Agenda:
1) Quick status by customer
2) Rollout gating criteria check
3) Blockers / escalations
4) Action items and owners

Highlights / notes:
- Canary rollout: Veridian Health moved to canary on 2028-07-25 (batch size 64, KV cache TTL=30m). Initial throughput looks good but KV eviction appears when request bursts exceed 1200 RPS sustained for >90s.
- BlueCove started synthetic load 2028-07-26; observed similar eviction but less frequent due to smaller shard profile. BlueCove is willing to remain in canary but requested an SLA for token loss remediation.
- Tidewater onboarding paused: IP allowlist for private deployment not propagated to regional edge (us-west-2) — blocker ticket RW-OPS-2102.
- Observability: console traces show mismatch between prefix cache hit-rate reporting (Console v2) and raw logs — discrepancy ~6% — Janice to file follow-up reproducer.

Customer updates (detailed):
1) Veridian Health (primary integration)
- Status: in canary (gatekeeper level 2)
- Recent changes: KV cache enabled, batch size tuned to 64, model pinned to rwinf/gemini-13b-v2-quant (canary variant)
- Blockers: KV eviction bug causing soft failures; customer reported sporadic truncation in long-form summarization tests
- Customer asks: confirmation of remediation timeline + roll-back plan if fix regresses
- Notes: Aisha to coordinate a 1:1 demo of fallback flows with Veridian success team on 2028-07-29

2) BlueCove Analytics
- Status: canary (smoke tests green), low traffic profile
- Recent changes: routing policy using cost-tier fallback to smaller quantized variant under high load
- Blockers: wants contractual credit for token replay incidents (legal/comms queued)
- Notes: Samir to draft credit language; legal pinged (Confluence-654321 for draft)

3) Tidewater Systems
- Status: onboarding paused
- Blockers: network allowlist + private deploy manifest mismatch (RW-OPS-2102)
- Next step: Ops to confirm IP blocks; expected resolution EOD 2028-07-28

Rollout gating checklist (current):
- Performance: p50/p99 within target for 95% of traffic — p99 breached during eviction windows — FAIL
- Observability: metrics surface for KV hits & eviction — PASS (but mismatch noted)
- Fallbacks: automatic reroute to non-KV variant configured — PASS
- Customer signoff: Veridian signed on for canary, BlueCove conditional — PARTIAL

Risks and mitigation:
- Risk: eviction bug leading to request replay and downstream cost spikes
  - Mitigation: emergency patch on serving-runtime (PR #2487), temporary throttle on canary traffic, revert knob ready
- Risk: legal/credit escalations with BlueCove
  - Mitigation: draft credit proposal and proactive CS outreach
- Risk: Tidewater network gating could push them to competitor if delayed >72h
  - Mitigation: Ops to escalate with NetEng and offer temporary hosted transit

Decisions needed:
- Approve hotfix PR #2487 for hot-path KV eviction patch and fast-track canary push (Engineering)
- Approve a temporary token credit for BlueCove (GTM/Legal) — Samir to lead

Action items (owner — due):
- RW-INT-1347: Engineering — deploy eviction fix to canary, add additional unit tests for heavy burst (owner: Marco Alvarez) — due 2028-07-29
- Ops RW-OPS-2102: Confirm IP allowlist propagation for Tidewater, provide workaround (owner: Ravi Menon) — due 2028-07-28
- Customer comms: Draft incident/credit note for BlueCove (owner: Samir Gupta) — due 2028-07-28
- Observability reproducer: Janice Lo to produce log-level reproducer and link it (owner: Janice Lo) — due 2028-07-29
- Demo: Aisha to run Veridian fallback demo (owner: Aisha Patel) — scheduled 2028-07-29
- Rollback plan: Claire to outline rollback steps and knob matrix and publish to Confluence (owner: Claire Donovan) — due 2028-07-28

Notes to self / open questions:
- Can we temporarily increase KV TTL for Veridian until patch lands, or will that distort production hit-rate metrics?
- Do we have cost-center approval to issue ad-hoc credits before legal final sign-off? (Samir/Finance)
- Need followup on Console v2 metric mismatch — possible dashboard query bug vs ingestion lag

Next meeting:
- Weekly Gatekeeper Standup: 2028-08-03 10:00 PT (same channel)
- Suggested prep: Marco to bring short perf diff after patch; Janice to bring reproducer logs

Raw links / refs:
- RW-INT-1347 (Jira): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-INT-1347
- RW-OPS-2102 (Jira): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-OPS-2102
- Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/2487
- Draft credit (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=654321
- Slack thread: slack://thread/onramp-gatekeeper/CK12345

End of notes.
